name: buddy
description: A little pet that walks right to left above the prompt: the Claude mascot, a minion, a cat, a bunny, a ghost or a robot.

skin.title: Pet
skin.description: claude (the mascot), minion, classic, cat, bunny, ghost or robot

color.title: Color
color.description: Color of the buddy; auto uses the skin's own color

rows.title: Height
rows.description: compact: a minion or face takes one row and the mascot two; tall: the mascot takes three (with legs) and others two

showWhileWorking.title: Show while Claude works
showWhileWorking.description: Turn off to give the row back while a turn is running
